نزدجر (form VIII)
# نَزْدَجِرُ (nazdajiru) /naz.da.d͡ʒi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# نُزْدَجَرُ (nuzdajaru) /nuz.da.d͡ʒa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# نَزْدَجِرَ (nazdajira) /naz.da.d͡ʒi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# نُزْدَجَرَ (nuzdajara) /nuz.da.d͡
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
